entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Head, breath, throat, chest; Stomach, leg; Grip, grasp, vice; Poison, acid, bile
entries.zh: 头、呼吸、喉咙、胸；胃、腿；紧握、抓握、虎钳；毒、酸、胆汁。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Sick, dizzy, breathless; Claw-like, hammering, overwhelming
entries.zh: 恶心、眩晕、喘不过气；爪子般、锤击般、难以承受。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Gripped, grasped, tightened, contracted, throbbed; Churned, gnawed, jerked, writhed
entries.zh: 紧抓、攥住、收紧、收缩、跳痛；翻腾、啃噬、猛抽、扭动。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Like a razor-edged breath
entries.zh: 每次呼吸都像剃刀划过

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 胃像攥紧的拳头般收缩

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 空空的胃里一阵阵啃噬般疼痛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 像虎钳一样在胸口越夹越紧

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 腿疼得像被爪子猛抓、抽紧

entries.zh: 全身每根神经都在尖叫，当……

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The gnawing in her empty stomach was making her feel sick and dizzy.
entries.zh: 空腹中啃噬般的疼痛使她恶心、眩晕。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The pain in his leg jerked with a claw-like grip and left him feeling breathless and sick.
entries.zh: 腿上的疼痛像爪子般猛地抓紧，让他喘不过气又恶心。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It felt like a poison had taken root in his stomach, seeping through his veins and spreading bile to the back of his throat.
entries.zh: 仿佛毒物在他胃里生根，沿血管渗透，把苦胆汁送到喉咙深处。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Every nerve in his body screamed at him, as the pain gripped his head like a clenched fist.
entries.zh: 疼痛像紧握的拳头攥住他的头，全身每根神经都在尖叫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: All thought drained out of him, as the pain tore through his head and left him bent double and writhing in agony.
entries.zh: 疼痛撕过头部，他脑中一片空白，弯着身子，在剧痛中扭动。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Face, eyes, nose, nostrils, mouth, tongue, teeth, lip; Muscles, arms, fist, legs; Cramps, ache, sore, sting, wound, bruise; Pain, spasm, agony, anguish
entries.zh: 脸、眼、鼻、鼻孔、嘴、舌、牙、唇；肌肉、臂、拳、腿；痉挛、隐痛、痛处、刺痛、伤口、瘀青；疼痛、抽搐、剧痛、苦痛。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Wounded, bruised, aching, sore; Red, deep; Wild, fierce, searing, hammering, stinging
entries.zh: 受伤、瘀伤、疼痛、酸痛；红、深；狂烈、猛烈、灼烧般、锤击般、针刺般。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Throbbed, ached, stung, pounded, hammered; Reddened, twisted, scrunched, tightened; Dropped, lolled; Bit, gritted; Bent, staggered, rocked, buckled, crashed
entries.zh: 跳痛、疼、刺痛、猛跳、锤击；发红、扭曲、皱紧、绷紧；落下、无力耷拉；咬、咬紧牙关；弯腰、踉跄、摇晃、腿软、摔倒。

entries.en: Pained look on his face

entries.en: Red in the face

entries.en: Fierce grimace

entries.en: Reddened and twisted in agony
entries.zh: 脸涨红，并因剧痛而扭曲

entries.en: Nostrils flared

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Deep lines creased the bridge of his nose

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gritted her teeth

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Mouth was set in a fierce grimace
entries.zh: 嘴扭成强烈的痛苦表情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Scrunched eyes tight

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Bit his lip until it bled

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Spasm crossed his face

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Mouth dropped open and tongue lolled out

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: There was a pained look on his face.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He rubbed his forehead, trying to ease the hammering ache in his head.
entries.zh: 他揉着额头，试图缓解脑中锤击般的疼痛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As she cleaned the wound, his face reddened and twisted in agony.
entries.zh: 她清洗伤口时，他的脸涨红，在剧痛中扭曲。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was bent in half by the cramps in his stomach. Holding his breath and gritting his teeth – he staggered to his feet.
entries.zh: 胃部痉挛使他弯成两截。他屏住呼吸、咬紧牙关，踉跄着站起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As the next of wave of pain surged through his shoulder, he scrunched his eyes shut and bit his lip.
entries.zh: 下一波疼痛涌过肩头时，他紧闭双眼，咬住嘴唇。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He gasped, as the wave of pain flooded through him. Scrunching his eyes tight and clenching his fists, he rocked backwards and forwards.
entries.zh: 疼痛席卷全身，他猛地喘气，紧闭双眼、攥紧拳头，前后摇晃。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wound had been torn open and was throbbing savagely. Nostrils flared and deep lines creasing the bridge of his nose, he gritted his teeth and got to his feet.
entries.zh: 伤口被扯开，剧烈地跳痛。他鼻翼翕张、鼻梁皱出深纹，咬着牙站起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her mouth dropped open and her tongue lolled out. With one final gasp, her legs buckled under her and she crashed to the floor.
entries.zh: 她嘴巴张开，舌头无力垂出。最后喘了一口气，双腿一软，重重倒在地上。

entries.en: Whites, sockets, tears

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Wide, bulging

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Shut, squeezed, scrunched; Rolled, popped, bulged
entries.zh: 闭上、挤紧、皱紧；翻转、瞪出、凸出。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.en: Rolled in their sockets

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Only the whites were showing

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Looked as if they were going to pop out of his head
entries.zh: 眼睛仿佛要从头里瞪出来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Tears streamed down her face

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her mouth gaped like a fish out of water and tears streamed down her face.
entries.zh: 她像离水的鱼一样张大嘴，泪水不断流下。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As she hit the wall, her head was thrown backwards and her eyes rolled in their sockets, until only the whites were showing.
entries.zh: 她撞上墙时，头向后甩，眼球向上翻，最后只剩眼白。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Cry, whimper, whine, groan, moan, gasp; Scream, yell, shriek, howl, wail
entries.zh: 哭声、呜咽、哀诉、呻吟、哀吟、喘息；尖叫、大喊、尖啸、嚎叫、哀号。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Small, low, ragged; Wild, deathly, piercing, high-pitched, ear-splitting
entries.zh: 微弱、低、破碎；狂乱、死亡般、刺耳、高调、震耳欲聋。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Cried, whined, groaned, moaned, whimpered; Yelled, howled, wailed; Gasped, gulped; Let out, uttered, released
entries.zh: 哭、哀诉、呻吟、哀吟、呜咽；喊、嚎、哀号；喘气、大口吸气；发出、说出、释放。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.en: Piercing scream

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Let out a small whimper

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Uttered a low, gurgling groan

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Moaned and writhed in agony

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Released an ear-splitting yell

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gulped for air

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Words came in painful gasps
entries.zh: 伴着痛苦的喘息说出话语

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She curled into a ball and howled like a wounded animal.
entries.zh: 她蜷成一团，像受伤的动物一样嚎叫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He winced and put his hands to his head.
entries.zh: 他疼得一缩，双手抱住头。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He let out a loud, ragged wail and tugged wildly at his hair.
entries.zh: 他发出响亮破碎的哀号，疯狂地扯着头发。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She crouched in the corner, with her arms wrapped around her, and let out a small whimper.
entries.zh: 她双臂抱着自己，蜷在角落，发出轻微的呜咽。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Writhing in agony, he clutched his stomach and groaned.
entries.zh: 他在剧痛中扭动，捂着胃呻吟。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She bent forward with her hands on her knees. Gulping for air, her words came in painful gasps.
entries.zh: 她双手撑膝向前弯腰，大口喘气，话语伴着痛苦的喘息断续说出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Half-mad with the pain in her back, she released an ear-splitting yell.
entries.zh: 背部的疼痛几乎让她发疯，她发出震耳欲聋的大叫。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Head, brow, eyes, sockets; Stomach, arms, hands, fists, knees, feet, hair; Ball, heap, ragdoll, puppet
entries.zh: 头、额头、眼睛、眼窝；胃、臂、手、拳、膝、脚、头发；球、堆、布娃娃、木偶。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Painful, wild, savage, searing, cramping; Half-mad, spread-eagled
entries.zh: 疼痛、狂乱、猛烈、灼痛、痉挛；近乎疯狂、四肢张开。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Buried, wrapped; Tugged, grabbed, twisted, clenched, clutched; Shivered, shuddered; Struggled, writhed, thrashed; Lay, sprawled, slouched, slumped; Bent, curled, hunched, huddled; Limped, hobbled, buckled, dragged
entries.zh: 埋、裹；拉扯、抓、扭、握紧、捂紧；打寒战、战栗；挣扎、扭动、剧烈翻滚；躺、摊开躺、无力倚靠、瘫下；弯、蜷、弓背、缩成团；跛行、蹒跚、腿软、拖行。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.en: Shakily, unsteadily; Tightly, fiercely, violently
entries.zh: 颤巍巍、不稳；紧紧、猛烈、剧烈。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 一瘸一拐慢走，一只脚拖在身后

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hobbled to the door

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Buried head in his hands

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The blistering pain made him crumple into a heap.
entries.zh: 灼烈的疼痛使他倒下，蜷成一团。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He pressed his hands tightly over his eyes to block out the pain.
entries.zh: 他用双手紧紧捂住眼睛，试图隔绝疼痛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She crouched in a corner, with her arms wrapped tightly around her.
entries.zh: 她蹲在角落，双臂紧紧抱着自己。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He thrashed wildly – fighting the pain that came again and again.
entries.zh: 他疯狂地扭动，对抗一波又一波的疼痛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He twisted his head and tugged his hair, trying to escape the searing pain.
entries.zh: 他扭着头、拽着头发，想逃脱灼烧般的剧痛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She writhed on the floor, clutching her stomach. Her eyes rolled in their sockets and sweat streamed from her brow.
entries.zh: 她捂着胃在地上扭动，眼球在眼窝里翻转，汗水沿额头流下。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She hunched her shoulders and bent forward, hands on knees, gasping for air.
entries.zh: 她耸着肩、弯腰向前，双手撑膝，大口喘气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He limped slowly away, with his foot dragging behind him and scraping on the pavement.
entries.zh: 他慢慢一瘸一拐地走远，一只脚拖在后面，擦着人行道。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His legs buckled under him and he slumped on the pavement, legs splayed and eyes rolling back in their sockets.
entries.zh: 他的双腿一软，瘫到人行道上，两腿岔开，眼球向上翻。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Staggering to a halt, she slumped to the ground.
entries.zh: 她踉跄着停下，瘫倒在地。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Curled in a ball, he shuddered and shivered violently.
entries.zh: 他蜷成一团，一阵阵战栗，剧烈发抖。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Clutching at his stomach, he doubled over, gasping as the pain shuddered through his body.
entries.zh: 他捂紧胃，弯下腰；疼痛颤过全身时，他不住地喘气。
